Coffee franchise opens Mesa, Arizona drive-through as part of steady market expansion
Mesa, AZ (RestaurantNews.com) Phoenix-based retail brokerage specialist Western Retail Advisors (WRA) has completed its fourth lease for Top Fuel Espresso, supporting the homegrown Arizona business as it continues to expand its local footprint.
The new Top Fuel sits on approximately one acre at 2937 E. McKellips Rd., just east of Lindsay Road, in Mesa, Arizona. It includes a unique dual drive-through and menu items including Top Fuel’s locally roasted “1968” espresso blend, specialty iced, hot, blended and energy drinks, sodas, tea, protein shakes and breakfast foods.
Created and founded by Jessica Denison, Top Fuel’s trademark, car-themed atmosphere inspired by Denison’s decade spent in racing, including as a Junior Dragster. It also underscores a commitment to local businesses, with all equipment, beans and baked goods sourced from the metro Phoenix area.
“Every new shop is a reminder of the people and partnerships that have helped us grow, and our new McKellips Road location is no exception,” said Denison. “The residents of Mesa – and so many others – have once again welcomed us with open arms. It motivates us to keep raising the bar in everything we do and to honor a brand that’s rooted in Arizona and supported by so many.”
Top Fuel got its start in 2017 at a farmer’s market in Apache Junction. Since then, the business has evolved into four brick-and-mortar locations at 1602 N. Scottsdale Rd. in Tempe, Arizona, 730 W. Guadalupe Rd. in Gilbert, Arizona, and two locations in Mesa – 1520 S. Dobson Rd. and now also on McKellips Road. The company continues to seek new opportunities for expansion.
“Top Fuel is a true Arizona success story. It has been my privilege to support their growth from the very beginning,” said Western Real Estate Advisors broker Darrell Deshaw, who has represented Top Fuel in all of its Arizona leases. “We continue to consider new locations that will allow Top Fuel to expand its reach and bring its specialty experience to even more neighborhoods.”
For the latest store information, visit TFEspresso.us.
About Western Retail Advisors
Western Retail Advisors (WRA) is a full-service commercial real estate brokerage firm specializing in the retail market. Based in Arizona and California, the firm provides master broker services, tenant representation, landlord representation and investment sales, combining decades of retail experience with up-to-the-minute market intelligence to help clients analyze and predict market trends, identify favorable locations and manage successful transactions. With local, regional and national market experience, WRA serves top retailers and Fortune 500 clients in more than 30 states nationwide. For more information, visit W-Retail.com.
